description: Get an artifact's metadata and version history; set include_content to fetch the bytes of a version (0 = latest).

id.description: id is the artifact's id (from a collection's artifact list).

includeContent.description: include_content adds the content bytes of one version to the response.

space.description:
space optionally selects which of your spaces to act in (an id or name
 from list_spaces). Omit it when you belong to a single space.

version.description: version selects which version's content to include; 0 = latest.

name: get_artifact

approvedBy.description:
Approval state at the current version (feedback pins to artifact_version;
 a new version clears it). Labels of who currently approves / rejects.

author.description: author names the human who created it (created_by, resolved).

blocks.description:
Block-level review (app#75-78): the artifact's rendered blocks, each with a
 stable anchor + text + current status, when the artifact is under review
 (a collection has requested review); empty otherwise. Use these anchors with
 review_block.

anchor.description: anchor is the stable identity - address a block by this in review_block.

annotationId.description:
annotation_id identifies the review thread on this block, when flagged. Use it
 in review_block to address a thread whose block was REWRITTEN (its anchor no
 longer resolves) - the only way to close or reply to it. Empty when unflagged.

kind.description: kind is heading | paragraph | list_item | blockquote | code | table.

rewritten.description:
rewritten is true for a thread whose block was edited away: it has no live
 block, `text` is what the comment originally referred to, and it is
 addressable only by annotation_id.

status.description:
status is "" when unflagged, else one of: needs_review (look again),
 needs_work (changes required), done (action complete), approved (signed off),
 reject_remove (should be removed). set_by is "human" or "instance" (who
 judged it). changed_since = the block was edited after it was last flagged.

text.description: text is the block's normalised content (what to read / quote).

title: Get artifact
